NSCameraUsageDescription Sensaro uses the camera to take and upload photos of forestry concerns (e.g., diseased trees, invasive species) or wildfire risks (e.g., dry brush). For example, photograph a high-risk area and upload it to notify local forestry services.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription Sensaro needs photo library access to upload existing photos of forestry concerns.
NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescription Sensaro monitors your location in the background to alert you when you're near active wildfires or entering a fire danger zone.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription Sensaro uses your location to show real-time fire danger near you and pin forestry concern reports on the map.
